name.en-US: Sts. Augustine Zhao Rong and Companions
name.pt-BR: Santos Agostinho Zhao Rong e companheiros

prayerExcerpt.en-US: O God, who have strengthened your Church through the confession of the Martyrs.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Ó Deus, revigorastes vossa Igreja pelo testemunho dos santos mártires.

meta.face: Three clearly different Chinese people, authentically East Asian (Han Chinese), none Westernised. Augustine Zhao Rong (centre): a former soldier of about sixty-nine with a weathered, warm-brown complexion and a BROAD, SQUARE face with a strong, wide jaw — a broad, flat forehead (the front of the head shaved in the Qing manner, grey hair drawn back into a queue), wide, flat cheekbones, a broad, low-bridged nose, narrow, deep-lidded dark eyes with calm crow's-feet, thin straight grey brows, a wide, firm mouth; a thin, drooping grey moustache and a short, sparse grey chin beard; a steady, grave, fatherly gaze. Lucy Yi Zhenmei (left): a woman of about forty-five with a pale golden complexion and a SMOOTH OVAL face with a gently rounded chin — a high, smooth forehead, fine, arched black brows, calm, almond-shaped dark eyes with single eyelids, a small, straight nose, a small, composed mouth; black hair parted in the middle and smoothed back into a low bun; a serene, gentle look lowered a little. Chi Zhuzi (right): a lean youth of eighteen, clean-shaven, with a golden-tan complexion and a NARROW, angular face — high cheekbones, a narrow, pointed chin, a slim, straight nose with a low bridge, bright, narrow dark eyes with single eyelids under straight black brows, a firm young mouth; shaved forehead and a long black queue; an eager, fearless look lifted upward.
meta.basis: No likeness of Zhao Rong survives; modern glass gives him a Western face and a biretta, which we set aside for a Qing-era Chinese priest of about sixty-nine who had been a soldier. Lucy Yi Zhenmei and Chi Zhuzi (eighteen) are two of his canonised companions of 1862 and 1900, chosen to show a priest, a woman catechist and a young layman; the faces and the Guizhou-Sichuan setting are our choice.
